featured.title: Nemotron 3.5 Super and Lightning: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Models for Agentic AI
featured.tldr: NVIDIA's open Nemotron 3.5 Super, a 120B-parameter hybrid Mamba-Transformer mixture-of-experts with 12B active, adds a built-in drafter and 4-bit weights, reaching 51.78% on SWE-bench Pro.

featured.title: Kronecker Delta Rule for Long Context Linear Attention
featured.tldr: KronLSTM replaces the delta rule with a Kronecker Delta Rule that edits one scalar association, giving provably bounded memory and better long-context recall than Gated DeltaNet and Mamba-3 at 1.5B scale.

featured.title: History Replays Itself: Unleashing Long-Context Capability in Linear Attention
featured.tldr: NoteBank adds a training-free sparse memory to pretrained linear-attention models, lifting Gated DeltaNet's million-token retrieval accuracy from 1.7% to 70.3% at almost no extra compute.

featured.title: ReplaySSM: Cache SSM Inputs, Not State
featured.tldr: ReplaySSM stores a checkpoint plus recent SSM inputs instead of rewriting the recurrent state every token, speeding hybrid-model decoding by 1.20-1.47x and speculative serving by about 1.8x.
